summary: Iteration 9 tested both backend and frontend for PDF import regression. Native upload implementation in code matches acceptance criteria, backend import endpoint passed with supplied PDF (200, private source_path, 250 tasks, no issues), and onboarding -> Plan Library -> Import screen renders on web preview. Real Android/Expo Go runtime was not available in this environment.

integration_issues.flow: Web import screen -> choose-pdf-button -> upload -> review
integration_issues.issue: In headless Playwright web preview, forcing input[type=file] after choose-pdf-button does not transition to review (import-plan-name not rendered) and no deterministic /api/plans/import-pdf request is observed in that probe. This appears to be a DocumentPicker web automation limitation; manual/device validation is still required.

action_items: Run physical Android/Expo Go validation for the exact user-reported path (native picker -> upload -> review) since this environment cannot execute Expo Go runtime behavior.
If mobile still fails, capture runtime logs around FileSystem.uploadAsync call/response and verify picker asset fields (uri/name/mimeType) at runtime.
Optionally add a web-testable import fallback hook for deterministic E2E automation (non-production test pathway).
critical_code_review_comments: Verified /app/frontend/src/import-api.ts native branch uses expo-file-system/legacy FileSystem.uploadAsync with MULTIPART, fieldName='file', PDF mime type fallback, and no manual multipart Content-Type header.
Verified no React Native FormData URI-object upload path remains in native branch.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while platform guidance references EXPO_BACKEND_URL; keep env naming consistent to avoid cross-agent config drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stop re-trying headless chooser selectors: 3 upload probes completed and all remained on import screen without review state. Focus next on real Android/Expo Go runtime validation for native multipart path and manual web validation if needed.
rca_of_issue: Backend parser/storage path is healthy (pytest: 3/3 pass with supplied PDF; includes 200, private source_path prefix, 250 tasks, empty issues). Static code confirms native migration away from FormData URI objects. Remaining uncertainty is UI upload completion in headless web automation: DocumentPicker interaction does not reliably emulate user file selection callback in this environment, so absence of review transition here is not sufficient to conclude product regression on real devices.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md before auth flows; file exists but contains no credentials. No auth flow was required for this test scope.
